title: Plugin eval task run 3 findings: grader import-mode, test-reduce stops after consolidation
description: Third plugin-eval task run (2026-09-26, /tmp/test-skills-plugin-eval/20260926-205004, Opus, 3 runs/arm). grade.py clears addopts and so dropped a project's --import-mode=importlib, turning one valid reduction into 6 collection errors. The with-plugin shop-reduce runs lost 0 of 274 kills (baselines lost 3 each) but kept 100-104 PR cases vs 46-62: they consolidated into tables and demoted the originals, then stopped instead of demoting the consolidated cases the certificate shows redundant.

acceptanceCriteria.text: grade.py preserves the project's --import-mode when it clears addopts, with a regression test
test-reduce makes the post-consolidation minimize pass explicit
Objective results for the run regenerated and recorded in the evaluation story
